skill.summary: Fetch web content using curl as a fallback when web_fetch is blocked due to private, internal, or special-use IP address restrictions.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the web-fetch-fallback skill.
- Provides guidance and best practices for using curl as a fallback when web_fetch blocks requests to private/internal/special-use IP addresses.
- Includes example curl commands for fetching content, using custom headers, saving output, and handling timeouts.
- Outlines limitations, security considerations, and recommended workflows for safe usage.
- Reference to a reusable curl script and detailed curl exit code meanings included.
